fee_notes: Standard fee is $49,500 per territory (~40,000 Qualified Residents age 65+). Veterans/first responders get 10% discount. Conversion business discount: 10% (<$250k GS), 50% ($250k-$450k GS), or 75% ($450k+ GS) — one franchisee paid $11,137.50 under this. In-term additional territory: 10% off. Multi-territory simultaneous purchase: $49,500 / $44,500 / $39,500 / $37,000 per territory (1/2/3/4). Discounts cannot be combined.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee is $49,500 for a geographic area operates as a territory with a population of approximately 40,000 Qualified Residents. During the fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, we discounted the Initial Franchise Fee for one franchisee to $11,137.50 under a Conversion Business discount.
